thread:
nora: Heads-up: Legal wants a formal deprecation notice for the batching change in v2 SDKs. The param `batch_size` is renamed to `max_batch` and the default is changing from 16 -> 8. This can affect latency-sensitive pipelines. I started a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/14299

ash: Important: we need clear copy for customers who rely on implicit batching. Recommend 1) announcement blurb, 2) migration snippet for JS/Python, 3) guidance on restoring old behavior via header while they upgrade.

leo: Suggest we include a short benchmark showing throughput vs latency tradeoff (16 vs 8) so teams can make an informed choice. I can run quick perf tests on staging GPUs and paste numbers.

paul: Ops ask: add an example of setting `X-Redwood-Compat: batching=legacy` for temporary compatibility and call out its only available for 30 days. Also include a note for Dedicated customers about reserved pool tuning.

doc-bot: PR opened by nora: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/14299 - title: "batching: param rename + migration guide" - CI checks queued.

nora: Draft migration snippets below - please paste into the PR:
```js
// v1 (old)
client.generate({ model: 'text-small', batch_size: 16, inputs: [ ... ] })
// v2 (new)
client.generate({ model: 'text-small-v2', max_batch: 8, inputs: [ ... ] })
```

```py
# v1 (old)
resp = client.generate(model='text-small', batch_size=16, inputs=items)
# v2 (new)
resp = client.generate(model='text-small-v2', max_batch=8, inputs=items)
```

ash: Add a tiny code snippet showing how to detect old param usage in server-side logs and emit a deprecation warning header `X-Deprecation-Batch` so SDKs can surface it.

paul: I'll add a redirect: `/v1/batching` -> `/v2/batching-migration` and a runbook entry describing how to roll back to legacy batching for customers on critical paths.

support: Please include a troubleshooting section: 1) if latency spikes, try lowering `max_batch`, 2) if throughput drops, consider client-side concurrency, 3) contact support with `X-Request-Id` and sample payloads.

ci-bot: Staging build started for PR 14299.

leo: Perf numbers (staging): 16 -> 120 qps avg, p95 latency 210ms; 8 -> 85 qps avg, p95 latency 130ms. I'll add a short chart and recommend defaults per use-case in the guide.

nora: Good data. We should add a short decision table: "latency-sensitive -> max_batch 4-8; throughput-sensitive -> max_batch 12-16; experimental -> try adaptive batching". Also add a snippet showing `adaptive_batch: true` config for SDKs that support it.

ash: Don't forget to update the SDK changelog and add a migration note to the quickstart docs. DevRel wants a one-paragraph community post linking to the migration page.

doc-bot: CI passed, preview available at https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/batching-migration. Ready for review.

paul: Reviewed and left two minor copy edits. Non-blocking. Merged. I'll open a follow-up PR to add a Go example and the redirect rule.

nora: I'll draft customer-facing email and hand off to legal for sign-off. Closing thread after customer comms go out.

support: After email send, please post the list of customers we notified so support can prioritize tickets.

nora: Will do. Thanks everyone.
